nodes.summary: Validate and load ECB history files.
nodes.instructions:
Validate the complete CSV before writing. Ignore the trailing empty field and N/A values,
preserve each stored rate exactly as published, replace existing date and currency rates,
and report the number of dates and rates loaded.

nodes.summary: Reject invalid ECB history files atomically.
nodes.instructions: Ensure malformed rows, dates, or values reject the file with exit code 3 and leave stored data unchanged.

nodes.summary: Fetch and load the ECB history archive.
nodes.instructions:

history loader. Keep the download boundary stub-able so automated tests use no network.

nodes.summary: List currencies available in stored rates.

nodes.name: Serve health and rate-store statistics.

nodes.summary: Return bounded currency history and summary statistics.
nodes.instructions:
Return inclusive date-bounded publication points and exact minimum, maximum, and half-even
six-place mean. Return 404 when the currency has no stored history.
nodes.name: Return bounded currency history and summary statistics.

nodes.summary: Resolve rates for requested and latest dates.
nodes.instructions:
Resolve each request to the latest publication on or before the requested date, return all rates
for that publication, and return 404 when no earlier publication exists.
nodes.name: Resolve rates for requested and latest dates.

nodes.summary: Convert amounts between currencies.
nodes.instructions:
Compute conversions with Decimal from stored rates, rounding the rate to six places and the
result to two places using half-even rounding.
nodes.name: Convert amounts between currencies.

nodes.summary: Run the HTTP service on the requested localhost port.

integer port, and stop cleanly on SIGTERM.
nodes.name: Run the HTTP service on the requested localhost port.

nodes.summary: Return usage errors for invalid CLI invocations.

nodes.instructions:
Resolve each request to the latest publication on or before the requested date, return all rates
for that publication, and return 404 when no earlier publication exists.
nodes.name: Resolve rates for requested and latest dates.

nodes.summary: Convert amounts between currencies.
nodes.instructions:
Compute conversions with Decimal from stored rates, rounding the rate to six places and the
result to two places using half-even rounding.
nodes.name: Convert amounts between currencies.

nodes.summary: Run the HTTP service on the requested localhost port.
nodes.instructions:
Run uvicorn in the foreground bound to 127.0.0.1, using port 8000 by default or the requested
integer port, and stop cleanly on SIGTERM.
nodes.name: Run the HTTP service on the requested localhost port.

nodes.summary: Return usage errors for invalid CLI invocations.
nodes.instructions:
Return exit code 2 without standard output for unknown commands, wrong argument counts, and
non-integer port values.
nodes.name: Return usage errors for invalid CLI invocations.

nodes.summary: Validate API dates, amounts, and currencies.
nodes.instructions:
Ensure malformed dates and amounts and missing required query parameters return 422, while
unknown currencies return 404.
nodes.name: Validate API dates, amounts, and currencies.

nodes.summary: Verify the completed application with the supplied grader.
nodes.instructions:
Run the supplied end-to-end grader as the terminal full-suite gate. Provide bin/test.sh for the
project's pytest suite and ensure both verification commands succeed.
nodes.name: Verify the completed application with the supplied grader.

history loader. Keep the download boundary stub-able so automated tests use no network.

nodes.name: Serve health and rate-store statistics.

nodes.summary: Return bounded currency history and summary statistics.
nodes.instructions:
Return inclusive date-bounded publication points and exact minimum, maximum, and half-even
six-place mean. Return 404 when the currency has no stored history.
nodes.name: Return bounded currency history and summary statistics.

nodes.summary: Resolve rates for requested and latest dates.
nodes.instructions:
Resolve each request to the latest publication on or before the requested date, return all rates
for that publication, and return 404 when no earlier publication exists.
nodes.name: Resolve rates for requested and latest dates.

nodes.summary: Convert amounts between currencies.
nodes.instructions:
Compute conversions with Decimal from stored rates, rounding the rate to six places and the
result to two places using half-even rounding.
nodes.name: Convert amounts between currencies.

nodes.summary: Run the HTTP service on the requested localhost port.
nodes.instructions:
Run uvicorn in the foreground bound to 127.0.0.1, using port 8000 by default or the requested
integer port, and stop cleanly on SIGTERM.
nodes.name: Run the HTTP service on the requested localhost port.

nodes.summary: Return usage errors for invalid CLI invocations.

non-integer port values.
